headline: Commercial radio reaches record audience as Spotify tests US ad skipping
date_line: Thursday 06 August 2026 · covering Mon 03 Aug to Wed 05 Aug
footer_note: Backfilled from feed archives, so it may be less complete than a live run. Built from 6 cited articles (UK 2, Americas 4). Written by gemini-3.1-flash-lite, gemini-3.5-flash.

digest.headline: Commercial radio reaches record audience as Spotify tests US ad skipping
digest.lead: Commercial radio has opened a record audience lead over the BBC in the United Kingdom. Meanwhile, Spotify is testing a controversial ad skipping tool in the United States as Sony prepares to monetise PlayStation games.

glance.text: Commercial radio weekly audiences have surpassed 40 million listeners, opening a record lead over the BBC.
Apple has launched a new legal challenge against a UK Home Office order demanding access to private user data.
Spotify is testing an ad-skipping tool in the United States that bypasses ads even for premium members.
Sony Interactive Entertainment is building a global sales team to monetise its PlayStation platform through advertising.
The CRTC has launched a call for comments on whether Selkirk, Manitoba, can support an additional commercial FM radio station.
Rogers has expanded its 5G wireless network to Matane-sur-Mer, a business hub in Quebec.

paragraphs: Spotify is testing a new tool in the United States that allows users to skip podcast advertisements. This tool even skips ads for premium members.
Sony Interactive Entertainment is expanding its advertising ambitions. The company is assembling a global sales team to monetise PlayStation through ads.
Rogers has expanded its 5G wireless network to Matane-sur-Mer in Quebec. The cable giant built a new tower to serve this business hub.

The CRTC is assessing radio capacity in Manitoba. The regulator wants to know if Selkirk and surrounding areas can support another commercial FM station. It issued a call for comments on Monday after receiving an application.
